name: Claude Tag
hook: Anthropic launched Claude Tag on June 23 — a persistent AI teammate that lives inside Slack channels, one instance per channel that the whole team collaborates with asynchronously. Already processes 65% of code changes at Anthropic; mandatory migration for Team and Enterprise plans on August 3.

name: CC Switch
hook: Cross-platform desktop app (Tauri + Rust) that unifies Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent in one system-tray interface — 108K GitHub stars and 43 releases with v3.16.3 shipping June 14. One-click provider switching, bi-directional MCP sync, cloud sync, and usage tracking.

name: Graphify
hook: Claude Code skill that converts any codebase, SQL schemas, R scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph — 71.5K stars. Generates interactive HTML visualizations and JSON graph files; Charlie Automates demoed a 70x token reduction vs. vector search for structural code questions.

name: Claude Code v2.1.187
hook: June 23 release ships sandbox.credentials to block sandboxed commands from reading secret env vars, org-configured model restrictions in the picker and CLI, and mouse click support in fullscreen mode. Also fixes 17 bugs: --resume failures, remote MCP calls hanging >5 min, CJK text mojibake, and background jobs stuck in 'working' forever.

name: Codebase-Memory-MCP
hook: High-performance MCP server that indexes any codebase into a persistent knowledge graph via tree-sitter AST parsing — 13.9K stars with 8,500+ gained this week. Supports 158 languages with sub-millisecond queries and claims 120x token reduction for structural code questions; indexes the Linux kernel (28M LOC) in 3 minutes.

name: OpenMontage
hook: Open-source agentic video production system that hit #1 trending on GitHub June 22 with 18.4K stars, gaining ~3,000 in a single day. Turns Claude Code into a full video studio: 12 pipelines, 52 tools, and 500+ agent skills handle research → scripting → asset generation → editing for roughly $1 per 60-second video.

name: Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills
hook: 817 structured cybersecurity skills for AI agents mapped to MITRE ATT&CK v19, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, and NIST AI RMF — 20.4K stars with v1.3.0 shipping June 22. Covers 29 security domains; new AI Security and Supply Chain Security domains added this release; compatible with Claude Code and 20+ platforms.

name: Skybridge
hook: Full-stack TypeScript/React framework for building MCP apps that run identically across Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code, and any MCP client — 1.9K stars with v1.1.2 released June 22. Includes HMR dev loop, local emulator, and cloud tunnel; team claims 500K+ npm downloads across 118 releases.

name: Recall
hook: Offline-only persistent memory plugin for Claude Code that auto-captures session work and summarizes it locally — no API keys, no cloud, no external calls. Hit Show HN June 23 with 448 stars; v0.3.5 released June 22. Solves the token-waste problem of re-explaining the same project at the start of every session.

name: Vibedock
hook: macOS menu bar app that toggles Claude Code MCP servers on/off in one click and auto-kills then relaunches Claude sessions on any change — no config file editing. Supports Terminal, iTerm2, VS Code, and Warp; saves tokens by keeping only the MCP servers you actually need active. One-time purchase, 3-day free trial.

name: Fable 5 / Mythos 5 Access Statement
hook: Day 12: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 remain suspended with no restoration date. Two firm milestones ahead: July 8 when Anthropic's ID verification system goes live (the most likely unlock mechanism for US users), and August 1, the EO 60-day deadline under the covered frontier model framework.
